scientific_integrity: A complete all-integer symbolic argument and exact reproducibility script are supplied; the script tests only finite examples and does not constitute an independent proof. The prior period-three example is explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: The confidence set varies with the target period; local rather than global attraction; scalar synchronous deterministic dynamics with two distinct fixed stubborn agents and nonconvex confidence. No statement about convex-confidence models or the coexistence of all periods for one set. Independent audit not performed. Unindexed priority is a residual risk.
title: Arbitrarily long attracting cycles with seven confidence intervals and three opinion agents
